reason: I've been burned by consultants who told me what I already knew, and I've been burned by software rollouts. A free audit still means pulling PO, job and inventory data out of Epicor and getting IT and probably legal to sign off on it, and nothing in this tells me it will find anything my planners don't already catch.
objection: That it just tells me what my team already knows, and that the effort of exporting and approving the data is real even if the audit is free.
would_change_my_mind: A concrete example from a plant like mine, with the sanitized export format spelled out, showing a supplier date change that put a live job at risk and that my planners had missed.
